info.title: CSI CRM Quantitative Specialist
info.description: Generates DAX queries from natural language and executes them against the production CSI_DATA_MODEL Power BI Semantic Model. Best for NUMERIC questions: aggregations, top-N, KPIs, profit margin, win rate, aging analysis, sales performance.

post.summary: Query Power BI Semantic Model with NL→DAX
post.description: Use for QUANTITATIVE questions only: numbers, counts, sums, averages, top-N, win rates, profit/margin/revenue, aging analysis, ranked sales performance. NOT for narrative/why questions (use ask-combined Qual agent instead).

q.description: Natural language quantitative question (Thai or English)

narrate.description: Set false in orchestrator/tool mode to skip the internal Thai narrative (faster ~6s). When false, 'answer' is empty and the orchestrator must narrate from data + top_accounts + advisory.

200.description: Quant answer with DAX trace + tabular data

answer.description: Thai brief narrative from DAX result. EMPTY when narrate=false (tool mode) — narrate from the structured fields instead.

advisory.description: Deterministic provenance/certified-measure/plausibility guardrail block (H3/H4). Append VERBATIM to the final answer — do not paraphrase. Empty when nothing to add.

value.description: Scalar value when aggregate-only with a single row

measure.description: Column name used as the ranking measure

top_accounts.description: Top contributing accounts when Account dimension present (orchestrator should cite these)

name_source.description: 'primary' = verified company name; 'heuristic' = best-guess from opportunity-name prefix — cite with a leading ~ ; null = unresolved GUID

is_aggregate_only.description: True when no Account dimension in result — orchestrator should cite 'aggregate across all accounts'
